program:
alphabet 0 1

is_bos = bos
is_sym0 = symbol 0
is_sym1 = symbol 1
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j, !is_sym0@i & is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j, is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_sym0@j)
h1_3 = rightmost(true, is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j & !h1_3@j, !is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j & !h1_3@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(!h1_3@i & !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_3@j, !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_3@j)
h2_3 = rightmost(!h1_2@i & !is_bos@j & !h1_3@j, !h1_2@i & !is_bos@j)
accept = !is_bos & is_sym0 & !is_sym1 & h1_3 & !h2_1 & !h2_2 & !h2_3

output accept
